label.description: Human-readable name from the source database (e.g. Ciqual French name). Populated when auto-imported.

cooking_method.description: Preparation state of the source row. Absent = raw (default). Cooked Ciqual / USDA entries (label contains 'cuit', 'cooked', 'boiled', …) must carry a non-raw value so the UI can group raw vs. cooked references on the same canonical ingredient. Use 'dry' for dehydrated/freeze-dried entries (e.g. Ciqual 'pomme séchée' → canonical apple): these link the dried source row to the base ingredient and are not used by the ML training pipeline.

meta.description: Source-specific metadata fields (group, category, etc.). Informational only — not used by the ML pipeline.
